title: research(REC): complete scoped six-primitive thermodynamic Jacobian and delivery
body:
## Why
The existing frozen incoming-history response does not include thermodynamic coefficient dependence. The next admitted H7 contribution needs the source-owned derivatives of M, s, T and P while the actual H5 history uncertainty remains uncalibrated.

## What this adds
At the retained z=1099.9986525171403 native source face, construct the six primitive columns (xe, xHII, ln TR, ln TM, ln nH, ln H): 313×6 algebraic state, 314×6 outgoing, hydrogen ionization, and a single Lyα number event with opposite atomic/radiation energy derivatives. Incoming313, grid, frame, geometry and query times are fixed. The physical pure-H restriction is the sum of xe and xHII columns.

The original primary failed after 13 completed RHS due to NumPy boolean JSON serialization. Its code, raw arrays and exception remain intact. One reviewed continuation reuses saved data and executes only the 12 previously unreached RHS. The original and layout-corrected figures are both preserved, with all four PNGs actually inspected by root and the same independent reviewer.

## Scoped result and validation
COMPLETE_SCOPED_THERMODYNAMIC_BLOCK; PASS_SCOPED_LOCAL_PRIMITIVE_JACOBIAN_AFTER_SERIALIZATION_CONTINUATION; material blockers 0. A–F pass: 21 reconstruction groups, six-axis complex comparisons, componentwise implicit residuals, nine identity groups and 11 restricted-seed checks, six mixed FD comparisons, three exact Fraction/Cramer cases, 14 high-precision escape probes and 27 refusal controls. Total 25 large plus six small RHS; inclusive CPU 8.362847 s, recorded execution wall 8.336637456 s, one thread, max process RSS 142720 KiB, within 60/180 s. No new IVP, native runtime or old campaign replay.

## Remaining boundaries

H6 actual incident trace/geodesic/direction/frame and the full coupled H7/thermal-ODE Jacobian remain open. The new stable J_s requires a consistently bound K_s; the prior represented K0 norm certificate is not transferred. Physical/U5 holds, global convergence NOT_RUN, production NOT_APPROVED and REI_activation=false remain. This stays a draft.
